evts.name: create_document
evts.description: Create a new document in DHC VISION by attaching a new information object and selecting a document type.

evts.name: edit_document
evts.description: Edit document content or properties in the system.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: Release a document through the approval workflow.

evts.name: distribute_document
evts.description: Distribute a released document to readers by e-mail or acknowledgement distribution.

evts.name: archive_document
evts.description: Archive an invalidated document by withdrawing authorizations while retaining archive-group access.

o2o.description: A document is created by attaching a new information object.
A document has a distribution list.
Archived document remains readable by the archive group.

o2e.description: A new information object is attached to create the document.
A corresponding document type is selected for the new document.
Document content or properties are edited.
The document is released through workflow support.
Workflow participants complete release tasks with electronic signatures.
Released document is distributed to assigned recipients.
Distribution list determines assigned user groups and persons.
Archive group retains read access to archived documents.
